title: Explicit open and biproduct base-change components
statement: Assume a fixed family of derived category instances for the module categories of all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. For schemes $X$ and opens $W\subseteq X$, let $r_W:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_W)$ be exact open restriction and $Rj_{W*}$ derived direct image [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Define $A_W:r_W\dashv Rj_{W*}$ by deriving the underived open restriction adjunction. Compare $Lj_W^*$ with $r_W$ by uniqueness of left adjoints to $Rj_{W*}$, with the $Lj_W^*$ adjunction pinned as in [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For $q:Y\to X$, construct $b_{q,W}:r_{q^{-1}W}\circ Lq^*\cong L(q|_{q^{-1}W})^*\circ r_W$ by this open comparison, the canonical pullback composition comparisons of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and $j_{q^{-1}W}\circ q=q|_{q^{-1}W}\circ j_W$. For a commutative square $(f,f',g,g')$, objects $K,K'$ and $\psi:Lg'^*K\to K'$, put $F=Lg^*Rf_*$, $G=Rf'_*$ and $a_0=\mathrm{BC}_f(K);G(\psi)$. Define $a_W:F(Rj_{W*}r_WK)\to G(Rj_{W'*}r_{W'}K')$ by base change for $f$ at $Rj_{W*}r_WK$, followed by $G$ applied to base change for $j_W$, then $Rj_{W'*}$ of $b_{g',W}^{-1}(K)$ and $r_{W'}(\psi)$. For opens $U,V$ with overlap $W$, define $a_2=F(\pi_U);a_U;G(\iota_U)+F(\pi_V);a_V;G(\iota_V)$ and $T(\delta)=(K\xrightarrow{(\eta_U,\eta_V)}Rj_{U*}r_UK\oplus Rj_{V*}r_VK\xrightarrow{(\rho_{U,W},-\rho_{V,W})}Rj_{W*}r_WK\xrightarrow{\delta}K[1])$, where $\rho$ is [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps].
